subject: SOC 2 / ISO vendor: scope, pricing breakdown and timeline
messages:
From: Anna Singh <anna.singh@auditframe.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 + ISO 27001 renewal proposal for Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi (and Marissa),

Thanks again for the intro today. As discussed, please find attached a concise proposal that outlines: scope for SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 annual surveillance, line-item pricing for audit activities (on-site hours, evidence review, testing windows), and optional add-ons (pen-testing coordination, additional locations).

Key highlights in the attachment (AuditFrame_Proposal_Redwood_2026.pdf):
- Combined SOC 2 Type II + ISO surveillance bundled discount (we can split if you need separate statements).
- Estimated timeline: kickoff week of Jan 18 -> report delivery by Feb 22 (assuming timely evidence).
- SOW includes two reviewer days on-site and remote evidence review spread over a 4-week window.

A few clarifying points we can address quickly if helpful: whether you want a single consolidated report or two separate attestations, and whether the SOC scope should include Dedicated (prod) vs Hosted (non-prod) buckets.

If you like, we can schedule a 30-min call Friday to walk the proposal and typical evidence list for engineering.

Best,
Anna Singh
Director, Audit Partnerships
AuditFrame LLP
attachments: AuditFrame_Proposal_Redwood_2026.pdf (pdf)

From: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Anna Singh <anna.singh@auditframe.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + ISO 27001 renewal proposal for Redwood Inference

Anna — thanks for the fast turnaround and the proposal. A couple quick asks before we book time: 

1) Can you provide a cost split (line items) for: SOC 2 testing vs ISO surveillance vs optional pen-test coordination? We need per-scope figures for our finance team.
2) Is the on-site reviewer requirement adjustable if we can provide remote recordings and evidence (we have constrained travel windows over Jan)?
3) For scope: we expect to include production Dedicated capacity and Hosted API endpoints. We may exclude ephemeral developer test clusters. Can you confirm any price delta for excluding those test clusters?

Cc'ing Marissa (procurement lead) and Monica (security/compliance) to bring them up to speed. Friday 11:00 PT works for a 30-min walkthrough for us — will that work for you?

Thanks,
Rishi
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 + ISO 27001 renewal proposal for Redwood Inference — internal: scoring and negotiation points

Marissa / Monica — forwarding AuditFrame's initial proposal. I pulled together a quick comparison of AuditFrame and one other vendor (LedgerConsult) — see attached vendor_comparison_q4_2026.xlsx. High level thoughts: 

- AuditFrame: stronger technical lead, competitive bundled discount if we do SOC2 + ISO together, pricing appears ~12% lower than LedgerConsult on the projected test-hours. Their proposed timeline is also slightly faster.
- LedgerConsult (procurement@ledgerconsult.com): better on managed evidence collection and has a standing relationship with our cloud provider partner (may simplify ATO paperwork). Their price is higher but they include 3 days of retest/cleanup in the fixed fee.

Negotiation asks I'd like us to pursue: 
- Line-item cap for remote review hours and clear definition of 'on-site' vs 'remote' reviewer days.
- Fixed-price remediation window (2 business days per major finding) — keep variability low for our finance model.
- Shorter payment terms (Net 30 -> Net 15) or escrow for the first milestone.

Monica: can you confirm the minimum evidence set we'd accept for a remote-only review (so we can push AuditFrame on on-site reduction)?
Marissa: if procurement can run the SOW redline with the concession language for fixed remediation window and payment terms, we should be able to close before holidays. I'll be on the call with AuditFrame tomorrow at 11:00 PT to surface these points.

—Rishi

Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, Jane Park <jane.park@outsidelegal.com>, procurement@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 5 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Selection: AuditFrame LLP — SOW redline & kickoff availability

Anna / AuditFrame team — thanks for the call and the follow-ups. After reviewing proposals and scoring against our criteria (technical expertise, bundled pricing, timeline, and contract concessions), Redwood will proceed with AuditFrame for SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 surveillance this cycle. 

Next steps and asks: 
1) Please send a redline-ready SOW (PDF + Word) that reflects: bundled SOC2+ISO scope, a clear line-item breakdown, explicit definition of "remote reviewer day", and a 2-business-day remediation window for major findings as a negotiated concession.
2) We'll need DocuSign-enabled SOW + invoice. Our procurement team flagged preference for Net 30 but we have room to accept Net 15 for the initial enrollment if AuditFrame can offer a small retention credit (we can negotiate that in the SOW).
3) Proposed kickoff: week of Jan 18, 2027. If you need to move earlier/later, flag now.
4) Cc'ing Jane Park (Outside counsel) to review limited SOW redlines and Marissa/Procurement for contracting.

Attachments: I attached AuditFrame_SOW_v2.pdf they shared in draft (please review & return redlines). Once we have a signed SOW I will ship a short internal rollout note to Eng/Sec to list evidence owners and weekly check-ins.

Anna — please confirm receipt and estimated turnaround for a redline SOW. We aim to have a fully executed SOW and payment milestone cleared by Jan 10, 2027.

Thanks,
Rishi
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
